name: Fog wipe monitor
description: A pinned video monitor that opens on a fogged proxy of a clip, lets you wipe it clear with the pointer so drops run down the glass, then sweeps a squeegee across the frame as you scroll and pushes through to an export panel.

stillAlt.default: A frame from a clip in FormCut: a misty city of rooftops and towers with a ship hanging in the sky

ariaLabel.default: FormCut clip monitor. Wipe the glass with the pointer, or use the buttons to clear it.

hintPointer.default: The monitor opens on a soft proxy of clip A002. Drag across the glass to reveal the graded frame underneath. Nothing renders until you wipe.

hintTouch.default: The monitor opens on a soft proxy of clip A002. Drag a finger across the glass to reveal the graded frame. Nothing renders until you wipe.

errorText.default: Fog is unavailable in this browser, so the graded frame is shown clear.

credit.default: Footage: Tears of Steel, (CC) Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0

finalBody.default: Preview and export share one renderer, so the frame you graded is the frame written to the file. H.264, HEVC, AV1 and VP9 render on your own machine, with no upload.

labels.errorText: Message when the fog cannot run

propDocs.still: Address of the clip frame. Shown clear under the fog; an uploaded asset path or an https address.
propDocs.finalTitle: Array of title lines shown above the tinted word, for example ["Graded frame", "ready to"].
propDocs.word: Text that the glass clears in a sweep when the page opens. On narrow screens each word takes its own line.
propDocs.accent: Colour of the tinted words, counter outline and marks. Defaults to the footage hue token.

fallback: If the picture or the 2D canvas is unavailable the frame shows clear with the message in errorText. With reduced motion the monitor draws steady glass without running drops, and scroll moves between three settled states: the fogged proxy, the graded frame and the export panel.
